data.name: Samuel
data.gender_notes: Samuel is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Shemuʾel: shama, 'heard', + El, 'God' — 'God has heard'. Its root is Hebrew sh-m-ʿ-ʾ-l. The prophet Samuel (1 Samuel 1). Samuel is a Hebrew name meaning “God has heard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samuel expresses “God has heard”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Shemuʾel: shama, 'heard', + El, 'God' — 'God has heard'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samuel total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
